title: Create your first linear genome figure
summary: Upload one small phage GenBank record, separate the strands, show labels and a ruler, and export the result without running a sequence search.

downloads.label: NC_001416.1
downloads.note: Download the complete lambda phage record as a GenBank flat file.

manualSteps.title: Select Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear before adding the phage record.

manualSteps.title: Upload the lambda record and name the output
manualSteps.body: Use one Linear input row and enter the output prefix. The optional record text fields can remain blank.

media.alt: First Linear input row containing NC_001416.gb.
media.caption: Upload NC_001416.gb in record row 1.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const seq = app?.linearSeqs?.[0]; const file = seq?.gb; if (!file || app.linearSeqs.length !== 1) throw new Error('Lambda GenBank input was not restored.'); seq.gb = new File([file], 'NC_001416.gb', { type: file.type, lastModified: file.lastModified }); app.form.prefix = 'lambda_basic_linear'; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.show_labels_linear = 'all'; app.form.scale_style = 'ruler'; app.form.legend = 'left'; app.adv.linear_track_slots_enabled = false; const row = document.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-card="${seq.uid}"]`); const badge = Array.from(row?.querySelectorAll('div') || []).find((node) => node.textContent?.trim() === '#1' && node.classList.contains('font-bold')); const label = Array.from(row?.querySelectorAll('label') || []).find((node) => node.textContent.trim() === 'GenBank File'); const uploader = label?.parentElement?.parentElement; if (!row || !badge || !uploader) throw new Error('Lambda Linear input row was not found.'); badge.dataset.capture = 'lambda-record-badge'; uploader.dataset.capture = 'lambda-genbank-upload'; uploader.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

media.alt: Basic settings with lambda_basic_linear as the output prefix.
media.caption: Set Output Prefix to lambda_basic_linear.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.form.prefix = 'lambda_basic_linear'; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.show_labels_linear = 'all'; app.form.scale_style = 'ruler'; app.form.legend = 'left'; app.adv.linear_track_slots_enabled = false;

manualSteps.title: Turn off sequence comparisons
manualSteps.body: Choose No comparison before generating. This makes the no-search intent explicit and prevents the app from running LOSAT or using a retained BLAST TSV.

media.alt: Comparison card with the No comparison command and Current: No comparison status.
media.caption: Choose No comparison; the status reads Current: No comparison.

manualSteps.title: Set strands, labels, ruler, and legend
manualSteps.body: Apply the four Linear presentation settings below.

media.alt: Linear Layout controls with Separate Strands checked.
media.caption: Enable Separate Strands in Layout.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.show_labels_linear = 'all'; app.form.scale_style = 'ruler'; app.form.legend = 'left'; app.adv.linear_track_slots_enabled = false; const card = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card')).find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Layout')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const options = Array.from(card?.querySelectorAll('label') || []).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Separate Strands'))?.closest('.grid'); if (!summary || !options) throw new Error('Linear layout controls were not found.'); summary.dataset.capture = 'lambda-layout-summary'; options.dataset.capture = 'lambda-layout-options'; options.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

media.alt: Show Labels selector with All Records highlighted.
media.caption: Set Show Labels to All Records.

media.alt: Axis and Scale card with Show Coordinate Scale selected and the Scale Style menu open on Ruler.
media.caption: Leave Show Coordinate Scale selected and set Scale Style to Ruler (Ticks).

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.form.show_scale = true; app.form.scale_style = 'ruler';

media.alt: Legend Position selector with Left highlighted.
media.caption: Set Legend Position to Left.

manualSteps.title: Generate and export SVG
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. Check that both strand lanes, feature labels, and the ruler are visible, then export SVG.

media.alt: Completed linear lambda phage diagram with two strand lanes, feature labels, a coordinate ruler, record metadata, and a left CDS legend.
media.caption: The completed figure retains both strand lanes, all feature labels, the ruler, record metadata, and the left legend.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const content = String(app?.results?.[0]?.content || ''); const svg = app?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg || !content.includes('NC_001416.1') || !content.includes('48,502 bp') || !content.includes('major capsid protein') || app?.form?.legend !== 'left') throw new Error('Restored lambda SVG does not match the completed tutorial figure.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 0; app.canvasPan.y = 0; } if (app.svgContainer) app.svgContainer.style.setProperty('transform', 'none', 'important'); const width = 1370; const height = width * svg.viewBox.baseVal.height / svg.viewBox.baseVal.width; svg.style.setProperty('width', `${width}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('height', `${height}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-height', 'none', 'important'); svg.setAttribute('data-capture-lambda-final', 'true');
